name: @activepieces/piece-slashed
description: AV1 video encoding and transcoding via slashed.cloud.

auth.description: Your Bearer Token from the slashed.cloud dashboard. Go to your service settings to find or generate it.

encode_video.name: encode_video
encode_video.description: Requests a video encoding job on slashed.cloud.

service_id.description: Your service ID from the slashed.cloud dashboard. Found under your service settings.

source.description: Path or URL of the source video file in the storage you have configured for your service.

jobs.description: Array of encoding job objects to apply to the source file. Each object must include a `type` field specifying the job type (e.g. `{ "type": "encode", "output": "output.mp4" }`).

priority.description: Processing priority for this encoding request.

callback.description: Optional URL to receive a POST request when encoding completes. Slashed will send the result to this endpoint.

aiMetadata.description: Submits a new AV1 video encoding/transcoding job to slashed.cloud for a given service ID, pointing at a source file (path or URL in the service's configured storage) and a `jobs` array of operations to apply. Use to kick off transcoding; optionally set a callback URL to be POSTed when encoding completes. Not idempotent — each call queues a separate encoding job.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Your Bearer Token from the slashed.cloud dashboard. Go to your service settings to find or generate it.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Your Bearer Token from the slashed.cloud dashboard. Go to your service settings to find or generate it.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
